title: Mouse Click
blurb: A clean, crisp mouse click — the tiny plastic snap that runs the digital world. Editors need it constantly: UI demos, decision moments, dramatic 'send' clicks. It's also weirdly satisfying on loop, as the entire mechanical-keyboard community will testify. One click, professionally captured, ready for every 'and then I pressed the button' story.
